subject: general
question: Which of the following events took place in the year 1928?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Bardoli Satyagraha** took place in the year **1928**.
 
• It was led by **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**, who later earned the title of "Sardar" for his leadership.
 
• The movement was primarily a **non-violent campaign** against the increased tax rates imposed by the British government.
 
• The success of the Bardoli Satyagraha significantly boosted the morale of Indian farmers and contributed to the Indian independence movement.
 
• The British government eventually rolled back the increased tax rates and returned confiscated lands to the farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kakori Incident:**

 
 
• The Kakori Conspiracy was a train robbery that took place on August 9, 1925, near Kakori in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It was carried out by the Hindustan Republican Association (HRA) to fund their revolutionary activities against British rule.
 
 
 
• **Dandi March:**
 
 
• The Dandi March, also known as the Salt March, was led by Mahatma Gandhi in 1930.
 
• It was a non-violent protest against the British salt monopoly in India.
 
 
 
• **Kheda Satyagraha:**
 
 
• The Kheda Satyagraha took place in 1918 in the Kheda district of Gujarat.
 
• It was led by Mahatma Gandhi to support farmers who were unable to pay taxes due to crop failure and plague.
 
 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel:**
 
 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel was a key figure in the Indian independence movement and the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of independent India.
 
• He played a crucial role in the integration of princely states into the Indian Union.
